scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The nonisomorphism, commutation-preserving map, and exact centralizer spectrum are proved for every odd finite field and integer m>=1. A previously obtained nonsplit-Ore count is acknowledged; the contribution is the split/nonsplit comparison and dihedral identification. Residual risk from general ring-isoclinism literature remains. No independent review or external validation was performed.
title: Indistinguishable commutation graphs of split and nonsplit quadratic skew truncations
